newsitem.title: INDIA: India call quiet, market awaits repos auction rate.
newsitem.headline: India call quiet, market awaits repos auction rate.

text.p: Indian call money was quoted in the 0.25-0.50 percent range on Friday, dealers said.
Call money rates are usually in this range on reporting Fridays when banks do not borrow as it increases their cash reserve requiremetnes for the next fortnight.
Dealers said call money rates next fortnight would be determined by the 14-day repos auction to be held by the Reserve Bank of India later on Friday.
"All eyes are on the auction," a dealer said. "It will determine the call rates for the next fortnight."
Market expectations of the cut-off vary from five percent to six percent.
